note:
Kenilworth Road on the 1901 census - four households, twenty people - read from the enumerator's page and checked by A. Hagues. The record holds nothing for this street in 1901.

**All four are unfiled.** The record keeps four properties here and names three of them - Iveston, Yew Tree House and Kenilworth House, with The Chestnuts at number 5. The enumerator gave no house names and no numbers on this stretch, so there is nothing to match against and the households are set down against the street alone.

The fourth group is the tail of a household whose head fell on a page not read - Olive Lewis and two servants, under the street heading only.
source: 1901 census enumerator's page for Kenilworth Road, Nottingham, transcribed by A. Hagues.
